newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mori Denki bid-only on third-party allocation plan.
newsitem.headline: Mori Denki bid-only on third-party allocation plan.

text.p: Mori Denki Manufacturing Co Ltd shares were up in Wednesday morning trade, lifted by news on Tuesday that it would conduct a third-party share allotment, brokers said.
As of 0051 GMT, shares of the middle-sized manufacturer of control and display equipment for rolling stock, were bid-only at 250 yen, after closing at 230 yen on the previous day.

Mori said in a statement that it would issue 8.9 million new shares in a third-party allocation to Hong Kong's Far East Organisation Finance (International) Ltd, a member firm of the Far East Group, in May.
It also said it had agreed on a broad business tie-up with the Far East Group, centred on Far East Consortium International Ltd.
